title: 第614章 巨峭城城主的邀请第613章 被这小子截胡了
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
噗！
看着陡然出现的木拐李，林晨也是彻底松了一口气，再次喷出一口鲜血，整个人一屁股坐倒在地上。
“林小兄弟，你的伤很重，这是五阶极品丹药青莲凝心丹，赶紧服下。”看着林晨奄奄一息的模样，木拐李面色微微变化，也来不及多想，赶紧走上前来，取出一枚丹药，递给林晨。
刚才正是蔡冕不断的轰击，余波将他吸引过来。
他就正好见到林晨御空飞行，被蔡冕攻击。
本来正准备出手，却发现林晨竟然凭空消失，他担心林晨的伤势，就赶紧循着追过来。
“多谢木前辈。”
林晨声音微弱，将丹药取过来，灵魂一扫，发现丹药没有问题，才直接塞入嘴中。
并不是他不相信木拐李，而是人性本就很复杂，他现在情况很糟糕，万一对方起了歹心，那就真是得不偿失。
随着青莲凝心丹吞入腹中，就转化成为精纯的灵力，流向林晨的奇经八脉。
太虚造化树散发出金色的光芒，一道道道纹蔓延而出，也开始修复他的肉身，弥补刚才燃烧的气血。
呼呼呼！
林晨盘膝而坐，运转“九转轮回诀”，周遭的灵力顿时朝着林晨涌动。
不远处站着的木拐李感受到林晨身上的气息，忍不住瞪大眼睛，就算林晨服下青莲凝心丹，他也没想到对方气息恢复的这么快。
他刚才可是感受的很清楚，林晨浑身气血混乱，灵力匮乏，整个人奄奄一息，毫无生机。
这才服下丹药片刻的时间，就开始盘膝而坐，开始吸收天地灵力了？
“这家伙的天赋也太变态了吧？”
木拐李满脸错愕。
时间转瞬即逝，一直到正午时分，烈日高悬。
整个天云山里面，再次掀起剿灭嗜血魔教的风暴。

得知天云山出现嗜血魔教的分舵，萧玄直接派遣了一整个执法队小队前来，加上袁畅等三人，整整十个真武境强者。
几乎将整个天云山翻了个遍，斩杀了嗜血魔教的四个真武境武者，唯独千仞刀傅邵廷以及蔡冕逃走了。
两人修为很强，一心想要逃走，除非是出动高阶真武境强者，不然还是很难抓住对方。
……
天云山外，聚集着众多武者。
“袁队长，这次真是多亏我们执法队，剿灭天云山的嗜血魔教分舵，不然后果不堪设想。”
巨峭城城主潘威看向袁畅，神色恭敬。
他很清楚，自己身为巨峭城的城主，天云山距离巨峭城最近，若不是此番袁畅等人出手剿灭嗜血魔教分舵，首当其冲的定然就是巨峭城，到时候极有可能连他这个城主，也会死在嗜血魔教手中，更别说巨峭城众多武者。
“潘城主不必客气，剿灭嗜血魔教乃是我们执法队的分内之事，只是很可惜让嗜血魔教的两个强者逃走了？”
“尤其是那个黑袍老者，对方的修为已经达到真武境六重巅峰，绝不是籍籍无名之辈。”袁畅缓缓地道。
“嗜血魔教分舵被覆灭，短时间他们应该不会出现，肯定会躲起来。”潘威缓缓点点头说道。
“嗯！若是接下来发现任何嗜血魔教的踪迹，劳烦潘城主立刻向执法队汇报，我们就先回去万法城了。”
content_en:
puff!
Seeing the sudden appearance of Muguai Li, Lin Chen breathed a sigh of relief, spat out another mouthful of blood, and sat down on the ground.
"Brother Lin, your injury is very serious. This is the fifth-level top-grade elixir Qinglianxindan. Take it quickly." Seeing Lin Chen's dying appearance, Muguai Li's expression changed slightly. Without any time to think about it, he quickly stepped forward, took out a pill and handed it to Lin Chen.
It was Cai Mian's constant bombardment just now, and the aftermath attracted him.
He happened to see Lin Chen flying in the air and was attacked by Cai Mian.
He was about to take action, but found that Lin Chen disappeared out of thin air. He was worried about Lin Chen's injuries, so he hurriedly chased after her.
"Thank you, Senior Mu."
Lin Chen's voice was weak, and he took the elixir over. He scanned his soul and found that there was nothing wrong with the elixir, so he stuffed it directly into his mouth.
It's not that he doesn't trust Muguai Li, but that human nature is very complicated. He is in a very bad situation now. If the other party has evil intentions, it will really be more than worth the loss.
As the Qinglian Heart Condensing Pill is swallowed into the stomach, it is transformed into pure spiritual power and flows to Lin Chen's eight extraordinary meridians.
The Taixu Creation Tree emitted golden light, and lines spread out, and it also began to repair his physical body to make up for the qi and blood that had been burned just now.
Hoo ho ho!
Lin Chen sat cross-legged and performed the "Nine Revolutions of Reincarnation", and the spiritual energy around him suddenly surged towards Lin Chen.
Muguai Li, who was standing not far away, could not help but widen his eyes when he felt the aura on Lin Chen's body. Even if Lin Chen took the Qinglian Heart Condensation Pill, he did not expect that the other party's aura would recover so quickly.
He felt very clearly just now that Lin Chen's blood and energy were in chaos, his spiritual power was lacking, and he was dying and lifeless.
Just a moment after taking the elixir, he began to sit cross-legged and began to absorb the spiritual power of heaven and earth?
"Isn't this guy's talent too abnormal?"
Muguai Li's face was full of astonishment.
Time passed quickly until noon, when the scorching sun was high.
Throughout Tianyun Mountain, a storm was once again set off to annihilate the bloodthirsty demon sect.
Upon learning that a branch of the Bloodthirsty Demon Sect had appeared in Tianyun Mountain, Xiao Xuan directly dispatched an entire law enforcement team, plus Yuan Chang and three others, a total of ten strong men in the True Martial Realm.
Almost the entire Tianyun Mountain was turned over and four Zhenwu realm warriors from the Bloodthirsty Demon Cult were killed. Only Qian Ren Dao Fu Shaoting and Cai Mian escaped.
The two of them have very strong cultivation and want to escape. Unless they use high-level True Martial Realm experts, it will still be difficult to catch each other.
…
Outside Tianyun Mountain, many warriors gathered.
"Captain Yuan, it's really thanks to our law enforcement team that we eliminated the bloodthirsty demon sect branch in Tianyun Mountain this time. Otherwise, the consequences would be disastrous."
Pan Wei, the lord of Juqiao City, looked at Yuan Chang with a respectful expression.
He knew very well that as the city lord of Juqiao City, Tianyun Mountain was the closest to Juqiao City. If Yuan Chang and others had not taken action to destroy the bloodthirsty demon sect branch, Juqiao City would have been the first to bear the brunt. It was very likely that even he, the city lord, would have died at the hands of the bloodthirsty demon sect, let alone the many warriors of Juqiao City.
"City Master Pan, you don't have to be polite. It is our law enforcement team's duty to exterminate the Bloodthirsty Demon Cult. It's just a pity that two strong men from the Bloodthirsty Demon Cult escaped?"
"Especially the old man in black robe. His cultivation has reached the peak of the sixth level of the True Martial Realm. He is by no means an unknown person." Yuan Chang said slowly.
"The branch of the Bloodthirsty Demon Cult has been destroyed. They shouldn't show up in a short time. They will definitely hide." Pan Wei nodded slowly and said.
"Yes! If any traces of the Bloodthirsty Demon Cult are found next, City Master Pan could please report it to the law enforcement team immediately, and we will go back to Wanfa City first."
